home_tagline: Your essays, always in APA 7 format.
home_empty_body: Create your first one and forget about formatting forever.
home_unreadable_files_one: 1 paper file could not be read
home_unreadable_files_many: {count} paper files could not be read
home_unreadable_files_help: Your readable papers are still available, and Tesina left them unchanged. If you have a backup, restore it from Backup Settings.
editor_export_missing_references: This paper cites a reference that is no longer available. Restore it in the library before exporting.
toolbar_apa_hint: L1 centered · L2 left · L3 italic — Tesina handles the APA formatting
cite_empty_library: The library is empty. Use "Add reference" to create the first one.
form_lookup_placeholder: Paste a DOI, ISBN, or page URL and it fills itself in
form_lookup_ok: Form prefilled — review the data before saving.
form_err_offline: Offline or the service did not respond. Try again.
form_err_unsupported: Work type not supported by autofill yet.
form_err_parse: The service returned an unexpected response.
form_err_url_unreadable: We couldn't read the details from that page. It may need a sign-in, or it loads its content in a way we can't read. Please enter the reference by hand.
form_err_unknown_input: That doesn't look like a DOI, ISBN, or URL.
form_pc_notice: Personal communications are cited in the text only and never appear in the reference list (APA 8.9).

form_day_end: Last day (if it spans several days)
form_film_hint: Authors carry the credit: directors for films, executive producers for series.

titlepage_warn_missing_title: APA asks for the paper title.
titlepage_warn_missing_authors: APA asks for at least one author.
titlepage_warn_missing_course: APA writes the course as number and name separated by a colon, for example "EDU 301: Foundations of Education".
titlepage_warn_missing_due_date: APA asks for the due date.
titlepage_warn_ambiguous_affiliations: Use one affiliation for every author, or enter one affiliation per author in the same line order.
titlepage_warn_heading: APA suggestions for this title page
export_warn_title: This title page is missing APA items
export_warn_meta: You can export now. These are suggestions, not blockers.
apa_check_skipped_heading: Level {found} heading with no level {allowed} before it
update_click_hint: Click to update & restart. Your work is saved first.
release_notes_unavailable: Release notes are not available for this installed version.
home_tagline2: Write and export in APA 7 format, without fighting the margins.
home_new_card_sub: Start from an APA title page
templates_sub: Start a student paper with an APA title page.
libm_empty_library: Your library is empty. Create your first reference.
libm_delete_uncited: This reference isn't cited in any essay.
libm_delete_cited_one: This reference is cited in 1 essay:
libm_delete_cited_many: This reference is cited in {count} essays:
libm_delete_cited_note: Each essay keeps its own copy, so its citations won't break.
libm_delete_scan_error: Tesina could not safely check every paper, so it stopped before deleting this reference.
bib_modal_subtitle: Review the detected entries and choose which to import.
bib_empty: No references found in the file.
bib_file_too_big: The file is too large (5 MB max).
bib_parse_errors_one: 1 entry couldn't be read and was skipped.
bib_parse_errors_many: {count} entries couldn't be read and were skipped.
quit_confirm_body: Tesina will save your work before it closes.
quit_unsaved_body: Your most recent changes may be lost if you quit now.
table_dialog_hint: You can edit the structure later with the table's pencil.
cover_open_form: Edit the title page in the form
refsheet_empty: Your references will appear here as you cite.
doclang_switch: Document language — click to switch between Spanish and English
equation_preview_empty: Type an equation to see a preview.
equation_preview_error: Couldn't read this LaTeX. Check the syntax.
equation_not_exportable: Won't export as an editable Word equation ({element}) — it will keep its original text
lib_export_scope: One .tesina file will contain your complete library: every essay, reference, collection, and figure. The file is not password-protected or encrypted — anyone with the file can read your work.
lib_export_privacy_note: Checksums inside the file only detect corruption; they do not protect or hide your content.
lib_export_success: Library exported. Tesina verified the saved file by reopening it.
lib_export_error: The library could not be exported: {reason}
imp_preview_intro: Merging never replaces or deletes your current work. Review what will happen:
imp_essays_identical: {count} identical essays are already here and will be skipped
imp_essays_conflicting: {count} essays differ from a local essay with the same identity — both will be kept; the imported one becomes a separate copy marked in its own language
imp_refs_summary: References: {added} added, {identical} already present, {conflicting} kept as separate copies
imp_colls_summary: Collections: {added} added, {identical} already present, {conflicting} kept as separate copies
imp_assets_summary: Figures: {added} files added, {reused} identical files reused
imp_rollback_privacy: Before merging, Tesina stores a complete, unencrypted recovery copy of your current library inside its app data, so the merge can be undone if anything fails.
imp_applying: Merging… Please keep Tesina open. This step protects your data and cannot be cancelled.
imp_success: Merge finished. Your library now includes the imported content.
imp_replan_title: Your library changed while you were reviewing
imp_replan_body: Tesina recalculated the merge against your latest changes. Review the updated summary before continuing.
imp_failed: The merge could not be completed: {reason}
err_not_tesina: The file is not a Tesina library archive.
err_too_large: The file is larger than Tesina supports.
err_corrupted: The file is damaged or incomplete.
err_future_version: The file was created by a newer version of Tesina. Update Tesina and try again.
err_invalid_content: The file contains invalid or unsafe content and was rejected.
err_stale_plan: Your library changed while the merge was being prepared. Try again.
err_recovery_required: Tesina found an inconsistency and stopped to protect your data. Restart Tesina to run recovery.
err_source_invalid: A file in your library could not be read: {detail}. Fix or remove it and try again.
recovery_resumed: An interrupted library merge was completed safely.
recovery_rolled_back: An interrupted library merge was undone. Your library is exactly as it was before the merge.
recovery_complete: Recovery finished. Your library is safe and ready to use.
recovery_required_body: A previous library merge was interrupted and could not be repaired automatically. Your essays are untouched, and all recovery evidence has been preserved. You can retry recovery, or export a privacy-safe diagnostic file (it contains technical codes only — never your writing) to get help.
recovery_quit_hint: You can also quit Tesina and try again later; nothing will be lost.
restore_consequences: Restore merges the backup into your current library. It never replaces or rolls back newer work; older conflicting versions appear as separate imported copies, and items you deleted after the backup was created may be added back.
bk_why_body: Tesina keeps your essays only on this computer. A backup writes a complete copy of your library to a folder you choose — an ordinary folder, or one that a service like Google Drive, iCloud Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox keeps synced.
bk_why_provider_note: Tesina only writes the file into that folder. It does not connect to any provider: if the folder is synced, the provider's own app handles the upload.
bk_location_body: Pick the folder where Tesina will keep its backups. Tesina creates a “Tesina Backups” subfolder inside it and only ever writes there.
bk_privacy_body: Each backup is a complete, unencrypted copy of your library: every essay, reference, collection, and figure. Anyone with access to the backup folder — or to a cloud account that syncs it — can read your work.
bk_test_explain: Tesina will write your complete, unencrypted library to this folder now, then reopen and verify the file.
bk_test_consent: I understand — write my complete library to this folder now
bk_test_running: Writing and verifying the test backup…
bk_success_local_only: Tesina wrote the backup and verified the file in the selected folder on this computer. If a cloud provider syncs that folder, the upload is handled and reported by that provider's own app — Tesina does not verify it.
bk_success_next: The next backup happens by itself on a new day while Tesina is open and idle, once your content has changed. Backups never block your writing.
bk_card_body: Optional: keep daily copies of your essays in a folder you choose. You can set this up anytime from Settings.
bk_reauthorization_body: Tesina v{version} hardened folder access. Select the folder again and complete a real test backup to renew authorization. Your existing backup files remain untouched.
bk_state_warning: The last backup did not complete
bk_next_expected: Next backup: automatic on a new day, while Tesina is open and idle, after your content has changed. It never blocks your writing.
bk_change_disclosure: Changing the folder leaves the old backup files untouched in the previous folder — manage them yourself. The new folder must pass a test backup before it takes over.
bk_turn_off_body: Tesina will stop creating backups and give up its access to the folder. Your existing backup files stay exactly where they are — manage them yourself.
bk_turn_off_done: Backups are off. Your existing backup files remain untouched.
bk_reenable_note: Choose a folder and complete a test backup to finish setup.
bk_card_pref: Suggest backup setup on the home screen
bk_run_success: Backup completed. Tesina verified the local file; any cloud upload belongs to your provider.
bk_run_skipped_unchanged: Nothing new to back up: your content has not changed since the last backup.
bk_restore_pick_body: Choose a backup file to merge into your current library.
bk_restore_empty: No backup files were found in the backup folder.
bk_retention_help: Tesina could not remove its old backups. Your existing backup files remain untouched; delete old “Tesina Library…” files manually, or choose another folder in Backup settings.
bk_err_folder_unavailable: The backup folder is unavailable right now — it may be offline, moved, or renamed.
bk_err_inside_app_data: A backup folder must live outside Tesina's own storage. Choose a different folder.
bk_err_symlink: That selection is a link to another location. Choose the real folder.
bk_err_name_taken: A file with the backup's name already exists in the folder.
bk_err_io: The backup folder could not be written. Check permissions and free space.
spelling_missing_dictionary: The {language} system dictionary is not installed.
spelling_unavailable: Spelling is unavailable on this device.
spelling_failed: Spelling could not check this document.
writing_coach_intro: Review one observation at a time, then decide how to revise your own writing.
writing_coach_specificity_explanation: “{observedText}” is broad, so the reader may be unsure what it refers to.
writing_coach_specificity_question: What specific person, condition, action, or result could replace “{observedText}”?
writing_coach_evidence_explanation: “{observedText}” makes a claim without nearby support the reader can inspect.
writing_coach_evidence_question: What source, result, or concrete detail would help the reader evaluate “{observedText}”?
writing_coach_clarity_explanation: The structure around “{observedText}” may make the relationship between ideas hard to follow.
writing_coach_clarity_question: How could you divide or reorder “{observedText}” so each relationship is clear?
writing_coach_economy_explanation: “{observedText}” may use more words than the idea needs.
writing_coach_economy_question: Which words in “{observedText}” can you remove while preserving the meaning?
writing_coach_repetition_question: Does “{observedText}” add a new point, or could you combine it with the earlier wording?
writing_coach_voice_explanation: “{observedText}” may distance the writer from the claim.
writing_coach_voice_question: Who performs the action in “{observedText},” and could you name that actor directly?
writing_coach_status_idle: Open Study to review this paper.
writing_coach_status_unavailable: This text cannot be reviewed right now.
writing_coach_status_stale: That passage changed. Review the current paper before trying again.
